verses.1: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.2: For his merciful kindness is great towards us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), simplified for children aged 8-12. Faithful to the KJV tradition.
